_comment: Session binding and setup freshness on the multi-hop wire (warren-core doc 116). A dated setup request carries the client's wall clock (Unix seconds) after the fields of its legacy request; the exit refuses a time further than skew_secs from its own clock and a setup key it saw within retention_secs. The wallet request's proof of possession is /v3: context || exit_id (16) || encapsulated_key (32) || client_unix_secs (u64 big-endian). SessionRekey travels on the data plane sealed under the PREVIOUS epoch and authorizes the next epoch's key on the connection. control.json and pop.json are unchanged.

control._comment: marker 0xC0, version 0x03, postcard payload. Tags 17 to 21 are appended after TokenRejected 16.

vectors._comment: tag 17: the IpRequest fields (prefer_ipv4 Some(10.66.0.42), client_pubkey = the pop_v3 key, wants_ipv6 true, pop_sig = the pop_v3 signature, wants_daita true), then client_unix_secs as a varint
vectors.name: ip_request_dated

vectors._comment: tag 18: the IpRequestV7Detailed fields (prefer_ipv4 Some(0.0.0.0), wants_ipv6 false, one token of 0xcd, wants_daita false), then client_unix_secs
vectors.name: ip_request_v7_dated

vectors._comment: tag 19: the IpRequestRoute fields (prefer_ipv4 None, wants_ipv6 true, an 81-byte locator of 0x3c, wants_daita false), then client_unix_secs
vectors.name: ip_request_route_dated

vectors._comment: tag 20, code 1: the time is too far from the exit's clock
vectors.name: setup_refused_clock_skew

vectors._comment: tag 20, code 2: the exit already saw this setup key
vectors.name: setup_refused_replayed

vectors._comment: tag 20, code 3: the exit cannot vouch for the setup's freshness now (its recent-key set is full, or it restarted within the retention window); another exit
vectors.name: setup_refused_busy

vectors._comment: tag 21: the new epoch's raw 32-byte key (that of rekey_frame_v2), then new_epoch 1 as a varint
vectors.name: session_rekey

pop_v3._comment: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) over the preimage. Same exit id, key and seed as pop.json, plus the time.

rekey_frame_v2._comment: A SessionRekey sealed under epoch 0 of the deterministic /v2 session of pq_hpke_seal_v2.json (same recipient seeds, exit id 0xa2, m_seed 0x44, x25519 ephemeral seed 0x55). The new key is the ct_X of a second deterministic session (m_seed 0x46, x25519 ephemeral seed 0x57). A DATA frame: empty pq_ct. The sequence number is not reset at a rekey, hence a large one.
